Package com.csse3200.game.components.cutscene

Class CutsceneScript

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.cutscene.CutsceneScript
public class CutsceneScript extends Object
A scripted animation scene: an mp4 played full screen. Loaded from configs/cutscenes/<id>.json, or built in code. 

 { "video": "videos/boss_intro.mp4", "skippable": true,
   "events": [ { "at": 2.5, "event": "openGate" } ] }
